verdict.rationale: No evidence anywhere in the pack of workspace/team admin controls—no mention of member management, roles/permissions, or org-level data policies; evidence covers consumer apps, API products, CLI, and MCP integrations only. This axis clearly applies to Perplexity given it offers Enterprise/team tiers, but no supporting documentation is present. Missing for 10: admin console for member/role management, permission settings, data retention/privacy policy controls for orgs, SSO/audit log documentation.
